hypothesis: Refreshing geometry-only uniform interior collocation at fixed capacity and accepted-step budget may reduce off-sample residual peaks. A fixed-point arm with identical optimizer resets separates sampling from reset effects. Geometry representation benefits must be reassessed against both controls after the same intervention.
initial_state: Exact frozen P2F step_0400.pt for the same method/seed. Both arms share the same state. No replay or selection of the first 400 steps. All prior source, geometry, loss and representation settings unchanged.
sampling: Three continuation blocks. fixed_reset retains the P2F training points. uniform_refresh replaces only the uniform interior subset at the start of each block using RNG 100000+training_seed+1000000*(block_index+1), 6000 total domain points and original 0.9 uniform / 0.1 fixed probe weighting. Three methods share byte-identical refreshed points within each seed/block. Original probes, boundary points, normals, weights and gauge are unchanged. No residual or FEM input to sampling.
budget: 18 continuations, three blocks of 400 accepted steps, nominal cumulative endpoints 800/1200/1600 including the reused 400-step prefix. Both arms reset L-BFGS history at every block. Save every block terminal and report actual accepted steps/closures, preparation/point-generation work and peak memory. Equal accepted-step and point-count budgets do not imply equal closures or equal total runtime. Development durations are not fair timing.
evaluation: All 18 continuations and every reached block state freeze before reading FEM. Evaluate ALL 36 prespecified new 800/1600 endpoints. Retain the 18 matching original continuous P2F endpoints as references, with their same frozen FEM scores and fields. Do not evaluate/select an unregistered FEM-best endpoint; 1200 checkpoints are retained for traceability but are not an evaluation endpoint in this protocol.
physics: Two NEW uniform independent sets of 24000 points, RNG 9285101/9285102, shared across all 54 new/continuous method-seed-budget fields. Neither set is used in sampling or training. Save five raw residual components; original and active training-point residuals; total/component means, complete 50/90/95/99/max norms, near/far-wall and corner masks (0.05/0.02 normalized distances), highest-one-percent mass, and independent boundary constraints using the frozen P2G quadrature rule. Reuse the P2G independent derivative-audit rule on all 54 fields. Continuous fields must be reevaluated on these SAME physical points rather than comparing different random validation sets.
engineering: Same closed P2F FEM references and complete field, point/node, wall, spatial distribution, fixed-region, convergence and extrema evaluation. Save full predictions and error norms for all 36 new endpoints. Joint research targets remain (U%,S%,wall%)=(5,20,10),(2,10,5),(1,5,2), reporting all prescribed endpoints without interpolation or engineering-acceptance claims.
preflight: Verify P2F closure/source/checkpoint hashes. Generate and hash nine fresh point sets. Check solid membership, unchanged counts/weights/probes/boundaries, same points across methods, Gaussian support response, equal capacity, exact inherited checkpoint states. Independent full-autograd objective/parameter-gradient checks on small subsets for every method/seed/block, and finite full-GPU objective/gradients. No software/environment changes.
interpretation: Compare refresh versus fixed_reset within method/seed first, and both versus continuous training to distinguish sampling and history reset. Then compare geometry with both representations WITHIN each sampling arm. Retain all seeds and both independent sets, using paired ratios and favorable counts, not an arbitrary combined score. The original two deteriorating Fourier seeds are a prespecified diagnostic subset; the third must remain visible. Lower residual is not automatically lower FEM error. This intervention tests common uniform refresh, not every adaptive sampler or a theorem of stability.
stop: Close after 18 continuations and all 54 physical / 36 new FEM endpoint evaluations. No additional seeds, denser points, altered bandwidth/geometry widths, residual-adaptive arm, T1/S1 or extra iterations within this protocol. Nonfinite values, input mismatch or early stop before the registered block endpoint stop dependent work and are reported; do not silently carry states or change budgets.
original_anchoring: No inference restoring original anchor-bias attribution. All prior frozen material remains unchanged.
